title: Where to measure from
text: The $$\theta=0$$ location is measured from the positive horizontal axis.

title: Find the location
text: Thus the location $$\frac{5\pi}{4}=\pi+\frac{\pi}{4}$$ radians is on the lower half of the circle.

title: Measure from $$\pi$$
text: Measure $$\pi/4$$ radians from $$\pi$$ radians. That is the point on the circle in the third quadrant that is half way between the $$x$$ and $$y$$ axes.
